messages:
anna: kicking off the blue->green shift for release v3.14.0 now. change window is 10m. tagging the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/orbit-shift :rocket:
deploy-bot: deploy started: release/v3.14.0 -> green pool (commit 9f3b2d). step=prepare, tasks=[image-pull, config-apply]
anna: checklist before traffic: healthchecks green, db migrations none, feature flags: orbit-new enabled for 5% only
ben: double-checking model service pins — we pinned the transformer backend to 2.7.1 right?
sree: yes pinned, manifest shows model-service:2.7.1 and quant-profile stable-v1
maria: perf note: last load test p95 420ms, memory within limits on green nodes
router-bot: starting gradual weight shift. initial weights -> green: 1%, blue: 99%
anna: moving to 5% now. watch p50/p95 and error rate in metrics dashboard (dash link in runbook)
ops-oncall: monitoring logs and redis queue depth; alert thresholds set: errors>0.5% OR p95>800ms will auto-pause shift
deploy-bot: shift progress: green=5% -> success. step=weight-update. timestamp=1800456830
ben: seeing a tiny bump in tail latency (p95 +60ms) but within threshold. no user-facing errors
sree: running quick smoke test on chat endpoint: /v1/chat -> ok, response samples look good
maria: note: a single backend node in green shows GC spikes, but cpu ok. I'll keep eye.
router-bot: advancing weights -> green:25% blue:75%
anna: holding at 25% for 2m audit. remind: rollback plan is immediate weight revert + scale up blue if we hit thresholds
ops-oncall: alert: error rate spiked to 0.7% for 30s, source=microservice:reranker
ben: can we narrow to a specific deploy? reranker shows no new deploys. maybe traffic skew to a particular zone
sree: checking traces, a new quantized kernel hitting on green nodes causes 502s in reranker path. suspect runtime kernel selection regressed
maria: agree. recommend pause shift and revert weights to blue=100% while we evaluate
anna: pausing. router-bot, revert to blue 100% and drain green gracefully
router-bot: weight update requested -> green:0% blue:100%. draining sessions on green: start. estimated drain 45s
deploy-bot: shift aborted by operator anna. postmortem tag: orbit-shift-rollback-needed. snapshot logs collected: s3://redwood-logs/orbit/1800456789/
ops-oncall: restoring capacity metrics to previous baseline. will open a high-pri incident if errors persist after revert
ben: capturing heap & kernel logs from implicated node, uploading to runbook folder
sree: immediate mitigation: revert kernel selector to stable-v2026-02 on green pool, mark quant-profile for repro later
maria: rolling back the runtime selector on green nodes now (ansible run). ETA 90s
router-bot: drain complete. traffic now 100% blue. no user-facing degradations observed post-revert
anna: good. we'll abort the rest of the shift, tag release as blocked until kernel issue resolved. create a follow-up ticket for controlled re-run with a canary variant (no reranker path)
deploy-bot: deploy status: aborted, reason=kernel-regression. logs & diffs attached in runbook. auto-notify: #incidents and #eng-ml
anna: thanks all. postmortem owner: ben. timeframe for next attempt: after ML infra patch and a small canary next week. closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
